method: Read each byte sequence; compare recorded size and Git SHA-1 of blob <size> NUL <bytes>. No source modified and no network used.

scope.suffix_count_warning: Counts are exact filename classifications, not semantic classifications of implementation versus regression modules.
scope.non_Checks_count_rule: Exclude paths under Lean/checks/ and filenames whose stem ends in Checks; count remaining namespace modules plus umbrella.

limitations: Snapshot integrity is against the supplied pinned Git manifest, not a new remote fetch.
Selected prior artifact coverage does not include every binary or metadata file in the complete repository.
No Lean compilation or theorem correctness conclusion follows from source byte integrity.

extra_local_prior_files_not_in_manifest.interpretation: Zero-byte residue from interrupted extraction; not part of selected manifest, verified corpus or semantic evidence.
